verdict: ERPNext BANK / RECONCILIATION READINESS READY FOR ACCOUNTANT CONFIGURATION
description: Bounded standard-ERPNext-first bank/reconciliation operating model: invoice/payment evidence -> operator verification -> #551/#714 financial approval remains a build gate only -> later accountant-approved Payment Entry -> bank-statement import or manual transaction capture -> reconciliation -> exception review. No live bank/accounting truth, credentials, feed, or Payment Entry submit.

Bank Account.inspect: row count + account_name/account_type/is_company_account if present. Never record bank_account_no, IBAN, SWIFT, or login.

Mode of Payment.inspect: name + type presence. Custom SBM MUR wire is not created in this packet.

Bank Transaction.inspect: count/presence only. Do not manufacture a live row to make the test pass.

Bank Reconciliation Tool.inspect: DocType/report presence. Phase C proved arithmetic, not hosted-test UI invocation.

Payment Terms.inspect: HTTP 403 to integrations@corpflowai.com is an existing #1019/#882 permission fact, not a schema gap.

Journal Entry.note: Bank fees and unmatched exceptions later post as accountant-approved Journal Entries. Not created here.

bank_feed.reason: Initial CorpFlowAI volume is manual bank transfer at 1-10 invoices/month. Standard ERPNext CSV/Excel import plus Payment Entry matching is sufficient. No operational evidence that a live bank feed is required. No credential or paid integration in this packet.
bank_feed.revisit_when: Sustained unmatched volume, daily cash-position need, or accountant/Anton later requests connectivity. That later decision is REQUIRES LATER DECISION and remains protected.

Whether receipts should post directly to the operating bank ledger or via a clearing / undeposited-funds account until statement match.
